messages:
Ivy (eng-platform): Heads up 1: sample anomaly on latency dash: p95 briefly jumps above p99 for the web cohort. Looks like a visualization inversion.
Rohit (console): that normally means mixed aggregation modes or tiny tdigest fragments. Which merge mode did the UI use?
Ivy (eng-platform): UI requested merge=client due to low bandwidth. Switching to server_merge normalizes the curve.
Lena (platform-ds): client-side sketch fragmentation + tdigest compression can invert percentiles when N is small. We should surface a warning.
Rohit (console): I'll add an "Aggregation: client" pill with a yellow warning when fragment_count > 8 or sample_count < 800. Also show per-quantile sample_count in tooltip.
Lena (platform-ds): telemetry: emit ingest.fragment_count and aggregation.mode so we can alert when fragments are high.
Ivy (eng-platform): can we also tag sketches with route_variant so fallback mixes are visible?
ingest-bot: ingest pipeline patched to attach route_variant where available. CI passed for roh/agg-pill PR #4302.
Rohit (console): deployed to staging, watching. Will make the pill copy link to docs explaining why pctl inversion happens.
Ivy (eng-platform): thanks all 1: will update the internal runbook about interpreting small-sample percentile artifacts.
